description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the ParameterPredicateVisitor class, testing its ability to visit various node types in an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) related to a query language and produce corresponding criteria objects.

classes.name: ParameterPredicateVisitorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ParameterPredicateVisitor's behavior when visiting AST nodes of query filters.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes the test with fresh instances of CriteriaFactoryImpl, ThingsFieldExpressionFactoryImpl, and ParameterPredicateVisitor before each test.

methods.name: constructorWithNullCf
methods.description: Tests that the constructor throws NullPointerException when the CriteriaFactory is null.

methods.name: constructorWithNullEf
methods.description: Tests that the constructor throws NullPointerException when the Expression Factory is null.

methods.name: visitChildrenOfRootNode
methods.description: Tests visiting a RootNode with multiple children and ensures the combined criteria are correctly accumulated.

methods.name: visitChildrenOfLogicalNode
methods.description: Tests visiting a LogicalNode with multiple children and creates an AND criteria from their criteria.

methods.name: logicalNodeAnd
methods.description: Tests the visitor behavior when visiting an AND LogicalNode.

methods.name: logicalNodeOr
methods.description: Tests the visitor behavior when visiting an OR LogicalNode.

methods.name: logicalNodeNot
methods.description: Tests the visitor behavior when visiting a NOT LogicalNode.

methods.name: filterNodeEq
methods.description: Tests visiting an EQ comparison node and producing the correct criteria.

methods.name: filterNodeNe
methods.description: Tests visiting an NE comparison node.

methods.name: filterNodeGt
methods.description: Tests visiting a GT comparison node.

methods.name: filterNodeGe
methods.description: Tests visiting a GE comparison node.

methods.name: filterNodeLt
methods.description: Tests visiting an LT comparison node.

methods.name: filterNodeLe
methods.description: Tests visiting an LE comparison node.
